title: Administrator provisions a new staff account

test_data: Username, Mobile, Organisation id: leave blank

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000. On the 'Sign in' page type admin@cmp.local in 'Email or username' and SeedPassw0rd!2026 in 'Password', then click 'Sign in'. steps.action: In the 'Search' box type uat.dco01@cmp.local and click 'Search'.

steps.action: Look at the 'Action' column for that row.

steps.action: Ask the test coordinator to confirm an invitation email was sent to uat.dco01@cmp.local (from the test outbox).

pass_criteria: The account is created in 'Pending' status with the chosen role, an invitation (link + code, no password) is sent to the address, and the register shows it with a 'Resend invitation' action.

title: Purpose form refuses incomplete or inconsistent purposes
preconditions: Tester is signed in as dpo@cmp.local.
Seeded purpose PUR-GAIT-TRAIN exists.

steps.action: Open 'Purposes' and click 'New purpose'. Without filling anything, click 'Create purpose'.
steps.expected: Nothing is saved. Messages appear, including 'A code is required', 'A name is required', 'Describe what this purpose is', 'State what this purpose lets you actually do' and 'Rule 3(b)(i): itemise at least one category'.

steps.action: Fill Code 'PUR-UAT-02', Name 'UAT Purpose 02', a Description and 'What this allows', tick 'Name' under 'Data collected'. Set 'Lawful basis' to 'Certain Legitimate Uses (s.7)'.
steps.expected: A new field 'Section 7 clause' appears, showing 'Choose a clause…'.

steps.action: Leave 'Section 7 clause' on 'Choose a clause…' and click 'Create purpose'.
steps.expected: Nothing is saved. 'An s.7 purpose must name the clause it relies on' appears under 'Section 7 clause'.

steps.action: Set 'Retention (days)' to 0 and click 'Create purpose'.
steps.expected: Nothing is saved; 'At least one day' appears under 'Retention (days)'.

steps.action: Set 'Retention (days)' back to 365, choose 's.7(a) - voluntarily provided' as 'Section 7 clause', and change 'Code' to PUR-GAIT-TRAIN (already used). Click 'Create purpose'.
steps.expected: Nothing is saved. An error at the top of the dialog reads 'That purpose code already exists'.

steps.action: Click 'Cancel'.
steps.expected: The dialog closes; no purpose PUR-UAT-02 appears in the list.

pass_criteria: Required fields, the s.7 clause rule, minimum retention and code uniqueness are all enforced; nothing is saved while any of them fails.

title: The office copies a message to up to five addresses; codes and links are never copied
preconditions: REG-01 and REG-02 completed: UAT DCO 01 (uat.dco01@cmp.local) is an Active Data Collection Owner, and no delegation to or from it is live (REG-19 ended).
The 'Your role has changed' message is copied to nobody (its 'Copy to' box is empty).
The background worker is running, so emails reach the test outbox, and the test coordinator can read the outbox.
test_data: Six addresses: uat.copy01@example.org, uat.copy02@example.org, uat.copy03@example.org, uat.copy04@example.org, uat.copy05@example.org, uat.copy06@example.org
Role change for UAT DCO 01: to 'DCO Admin', then back to 'Data Collection Owner'; Reason: UAT - copy check

steps.action: Open http://localhost:3000. On the 'Sign in' page type admin@cmp.local in 'Email or username' and SeedPassw0rd!2026 in 'Password', then click 'Sign in'. On the 'Verify it is you' page, ask the test coordinator for the sign-in code sent to admin@cmp.local (from the test outbox), type it in '6-digit code' and click 'Verify and continue'.
steps.expected: The Dashboard opens. The top-right corner of the header shows 'System Admin' with the role badge 'Administrator'.

steps.action: In the sidebar under 'Your work' click 'Message templates'. Under 'Sign-in' look at the cards 'Staff sign-in code', 'Password reset code' and 'Staff account invitation'.
steps.expected: None of the three has a 'Copy to' box. Each shows, with a padlock, the line 'Never copied: it carries a code or a link, or a person's own record, and a copy would hand it to somebody else.' A code or a link is never copied.

steps.action: Scroll to the heading 'Accounts' and find the card 'Your role has changed'.
steps.expected: The card shows a 'Copy to' box with the hint 'Email only. Up to 5 addresses, one per line - a team mailbox, an approvals inbox. Each copy gets the same email, in Cc.' The box is empty (grey example approvals@example.org) and the 'Save copies' button is greyed out.

steps.action: In 'Copy to' type the six addresses from the test data, one per line.
steps.expected: 'Save copies' stays greyed out: more than five addresses cannot be saved.

steps.action: Delete the sixth line (uat.copy06@example.org) and replace the second line with not-an-address. Click 'Save copies'.
steps.expected: A red message 'Not saved' reads 'Not an email address: not-an-address'. Nothing is saved.

steps.action: Reload the page and find the 'Your role has changed' card again.
steps.expected: 'Copy to' is empty again: the refused list was not kept.

steps.action: Type uat.copy01@example.org and uat.copy02@example.org in 'Copy to', one per line, and click 'Save copies'. Reload the page.
steps.expected: A green message 'Copied to 2 addresses' appears. After the reload the card's 'Copy to' box still lists both addresses.

steps.action: Click 'Users', type uat.dco01@cmp.local in 'Search' and click 'Search'. Click 'Role' on the UAT DCO 01 row. In the 'Change role' dialog choose 'DCO Admin' in 'New role', type 'UAT - copy check' in 'Reason' and click 'Change role'.
steps.expected: A green message 'Role changed' appears and the row shows Role 'DCO Admin'.

steps.action: Ask the test coordinator for the newest email to uat.dco01@cmp.local in the test outbox.

steps.action: Back on 'Users', click 'Role' on the UAT DCO 01 row again, choose 'Data Collection Owner' in 'New role' and click 'Change role'.
steps.expected: 'Role changed' appears and the row shows Role 'Data Collection Owner' again (this email is copied too).

steps.action: Return to 'Message templates', clear the 'Copy to' box of 'Your role has changed' and click 'Save copies'.
steps.expected: A green message 'No longer copied' appears and the box stays empty after a reload.

steps.action: Click 'Audit trail'. In 'Area' choose 'Messages' and in 'Event' choose 'Copies updated'. Click the newest row, then 'Show raw JSON'.
steps.expected: The two newest rows are 'Message template copies updated' by 'System Admin' with the 'Administrator' badge, timed at the two saves (the refused save is not there). pass_criteria: A copyable message is copied to at most five valid addresses - six or a malformed one are refused and nothing is kept; the copies travel in Cc on the same email; messages carrying a code or a link offer no 'Copy to' at all; every saved change is audited by count, never by address.
